Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-
G in the area bound by:

A line 169.5 feet north of and parallel to West 18th Street: South Racine Avenue; a
line 73.5 feet north of and parallel to West 18th Street; and the public alley next west
of and parallel to South Racine Avenue,.

to those of B3-2 Community Shopping District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1714-18 South Racine Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.
